research:
Season context: opener for both teams. 2025-26: LAL 53-29 (ORtg 118.2, DRtg 116.4, pace 98.3); GS 37-45 (115.0/115.6/99.0) (Basketball-Reference). Ratings are stale because both rosters changed.
LAL offseason (ESPN, Newsweek): LeBron left for PHI; Walker Kessler came in by sign-and-trade (4 yr/$129.5M); the Lakers signed Sexton, Grimes and Mamukelashvili, while Kennard went to PHX and Smart to HOU. The team is now built around Doncic, Reaves and Kessler under JJ Redick.
Usage 2025-26 (Basketball-Reference): Doncic 38.1%, Curry 32.5%, Reaves 26.7%, Sexton 25.9% (CHA/CHI), Melton 25.4%, Hardy 24.4% (deep bench); Butler 23.3% (out). With LeBron (27.2%) gone, more of the touches go to Luka and Reaves.
DvP (Rotogrinders FD cheat sheet, rank 1 = most allowed): LAL PG 48.87 FPPG (2nd), SG 42.96 (1st), SF 2nd, C 4th; GS PG 47.78 (5th), SG 37.22 (25th). Fantasy Team Advice has GS 20th of 30 vs PG (11th-most), so Luka's gate is borderline. LAL's figures predate Kessler.
Hit rates (2025-26 game logs): Luka 22+ pts 60/64, 4+ reb 60/64, 3+ ast 62/64 (4+ 59/64); Curry 11+ pts 41/43, 1+ reb 41/43, 2+ ast 41/43. Luka averaged 33.5/7.7/8.3 and Curry 26.6/3.6/4.7.
SGP: these 93% legs multiply to about 0.81. Alt prices are estimated from the main lines with a normal approximation plus alt-ladder hold (Luka pts -1067, reb -1319, ast -2601; Curry pts -1787), for an implied 0.775 (about -344). True probability is 0.777 after shrinking for correlation, minus about 0.015 for the risk Curry's sprain limits his minutes: 0.762. No edge, and the parlay is shorter than -300.
Totals (method): pace avg 98.65. GS = avg(115.0, 116.4) x 0.9865 = 114.1; LAL = avg(118.2, 115.6) x 0.9865 = 115.3; total 229.5 vs DK 234.5 (opened 231.5). That is 5 points under, so the Under is a leg. The model margin is LAL +1.2 before home court.
Injuries (ESPN/AP, Bleacher Report, Heavy, Lakers Nation): GS out Butler (knee), Porzingis, Podziemski (back), Moody (knee); Bassey questionable; Curry probable with a right ankle sprain from Sunday's practice, practiced Monday, and Kerr says he is 'fine'. LAL: Sexton questionable (calf), Thiero and Carr out.
Lines (ESPN DK): LAL -6.5 (-108)/GS +6.5 (-112), opened -5.5; total 234.5 (o -112/u -108), opened 231.5; ML LAL -218/GS +180 (opened -205/+170). Other sites have spreads of -5.5 to -7.5 and totals of 229.5 to 235.5.
Predictors: ESPN BPI LAL 77.5%; iHeart computer LAL 118-111 (total 229.1); Lineups.com LAL 120-114 and Over 233.5; Sportytrader LAL -6.5; CappersPicks AI LAL. Consensus is LAL, split on the total.
Preseason: GS beat LAL 124-98 and 101-89 (Kessler 11 pts, 9 reb in 16 min in Kessler's debut); LAL went 2-3, GS 4-1. These are preseason results, so they carry little weight.
Props seen: Luka pts 32.5 (o -118/u -115 SportsGambler), reb 7.5 (Polymarket 51c, ATS.io likes the over), ast 7.5 (o -120/u -114; o8.5 +112); Curry pts 24.5 (o -104 SI) or 25.5 (o -108/u -127 SportsGambler), pts+ast 28.5 (o -111 Tony's Picks).
Coaching: Redick wants a better rebounding team (Kessler at C); Kerr will likely manage Curry's load this season (CBS). GS is thin in the frontcourt with Porzingis out (Horford, Green, Bassey questionable).
Chemistry: LAL has a new supporting cast around Luka (Kessler, Grimes, Sexton); GS has a depleted rotation and no Butler, so Curry carries more of the offense.
Most likely leg: Luka o21.5 points, given 60/64 last season and a larger role.
